summary: Transformers publishes few measured results about its own software, all in docs/source/en: a pipeline batching example with runnable code and committed output on a GTX 970 (187.52 it/s unbatched vs 2554.43 it/s at batch_size=256), an expert-parallel training table on 8xH100 (3485 vs 2830 tokens/s/GPU, 38.6 GB vs 32.3 GB peak memory) with no script, and single-sentence speedups (up to 33x for the torchvision image-processor backend, 1.66x for a Metal attention kernel, 3-6x for DeepGEMM FP8 kernels) with no data. Its torch.compile, tensor-parallel and image-processor benchmark figures exist only as Hub datasets and chart images, and the benchmark_v2 harness and continuous-batching benchmark script push results to Hub datasets (hf-benchmarks/transformers) with nothing committed to the repo.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
